cancellationPolicy.compactBody: >24 h before → full refund · 12–24 h before → 50% refund · <12 h or no-show → no refund
cancellationPolicy.intro: We understand that life happens and plans sometimes change. To honour the commitment made by both you and your expert — who has dedicated this time exclusively for you — the following cancellation policy applies to all bookings:
cancellationPolicy.tier3Suffix: before your session or no-show → No refund
cancellationPolicy.rescheduleNote: Need to change your time? You can reschedule for free as long as you do so more than 12 hours before your session — simply use the Reschedule option in your booking.
cancellationPolicy.expertCancelNote: If your expert cancels for any reason, you will always receive a <1>full refund</1> regardless of timing.
cancellationPolicy.footer: Cancellations are processed based on the time your request is received by Sage Nest. If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

healthConsent.heading: Consent to processing
healthConsent.flowA: I expressly consent to Sage Nest processing my health-related booking data to manage my appointment, scheduling, appointment communications, and related payments. I understand that I can withdraw my consent at any time.
healthConsent.flowB: I confirm that I hold parental responsibility for the child who is the recipient of this booking, and I expressly consent on the child's behalf to Sage Nest processing the child's health-related booking data to manage the child's appointment, scheduling, appointment communications, and related payments. I understand that I can withdraw this consent at any time.
healthConsent.helper: You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to hello@sagenest.org. Withdrawing before the session cancels the booking. It does not delete invoicing and tax records we are required to keep.

withdrawalBlock.label: The session is booked within the next 14 days. I ask that it goes ahead on the date I chose, before the withdrawal period ends, and accept that I lose the right of withdrawal once the session has taken place.
withdrawalBlock.whyBody: By law you have 14 days from confirming a booking to change your mind and get a refund. Your chosen date falls inside those 14 days, so we need you to confirm you still want it. Nothing changes about your session time. Once it has taken place, the 14-day right no longer applies.

confirmStep.title: Confirm your booking
confirmStep.subtitle: Review your details below before proceeding to payment.
confirmStep.healthcareNotice: Sage Nest is a booking platform and does not provide healthcare services. The professionals on the platform are independent: the contract for the session is concluded directly between you and the professional. If you believe you or your child need urgent medical care, call 112.
